species.name: Trout
why: Water 48°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 12–26 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 65 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: Yellow perch
why: Water 48°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.

The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 65 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: Smallmouth bass
why: Water 48°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.

Northeast wind at 26 mph pushes bait onto the southwest shore: try the wind-blown banks.
